newsitem.title: FRANCE: Mobutu says will return home after Swiss check-up.
newsitem.headline: Mobutu says will return home after Swiss check-up.

text.p: Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko said on Tuesday he was "feeling more or less well" and would return to his strife-torn country after a three-day check-up in Switzerland following his current convalescence on the Riviera.
Mobutu, in a brief interview with TF-1 television, did not say how long his convalescence following a prostate cancer operation in Switzerland in August would last.
"After my convalescence here, I'll go back where I was operated so they can do a three-day check-up. Then I'll go home," he said.
Mobutu said Rwanda had "stabbed him in the back" and that refugees from that country now on his territory "were a source of many problems...and should go home".

The Zairean leader arrived at his luxury villa near Monte Carlo last week and has since received officials of several governments involved in the creation of an international force to rescue hundreds of thousands of mostly-Rwandan refugees in eastern Zaire.
